about: What this member said on the floor, from the Congressional Record: their own words only, and of those the sentences that name an alignment question's phrases or make a commitment. Written by npm run record:collect (scripts/collect-record.mjs).
name: Burgess Owens

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SALUTING OUR VETERANS
statements.title: SALUTING OUR VETERANS
sentences: Our Founders sought to create a more perfect Union.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROTECT ECONOMIC AND ACADEMIC FREEDOM ACT OF 2026
statements.title: PROTECT ECONOMIC AND ACADEMIC FREEDOM ACT OF 2026
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today in strong support of H.R. 4795, the Protect Economic and Academic Freedom Act.
I am grateful for Dr. Foxx and her leadership in this space, and I urge all of my colleagues to vote ``yes'' on this measure.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: MOMENT OF SILENCE HONORING ANNIVERSARY OF CHARLIE KIRK'S DEATH
statements.title: MOMENT OF SILENCE HONORING ANNIVERSARY OF CHARLIE KIRK'S DEATH
sentences: Charlie believed that we could become a more perfect Union through conversations and spirited debates.
May God watch over the Kirk family, and we will carry forward what he taught us: to argue with conviction, and do it without hate. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROTECTING DOMESTIC MINING ACT OF 2025
statements.title: PROTECTING DOMESTIC MINING ACT OF 2025
sentences: It only protects China's monopoly and smothers American innovation before it can break ground.
Mr. Speaker, I rise in support of H.R. 1501, the Protecting Domestic Mining Act.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to support this bill.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: NO AID FOR GHOST STUDENTS ACT OF 2026
statements.title: NO AID FOR GHOST STUDENTS ACT OF 2026
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to support this commonsense bill.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: NO FUNDS FOR REPEAT CHILD CARE VIOLATIONS ACT OF 2026
statements.title: NO FUNDS FOR REPEAT CHILD CARE VIOLATIONS ACT OF 2026
sentences: Recent reporting has revealed shocking degrees of waste, fraud, and abuse in Minnesota's Federal childcare assistance program.
According to U.S. Department of Health and Human Services, HHS, data, the rate of improper payments in Minnesota's Federal childcare assistance program is nearly twice the national average.
In May 2025, an HHS audit of Minnesota's Federal childcare program found repeated failures to verify attendance and comply with payment requirements.
Since 2002, the Child Care and Development Block Grant, CCDBG, has been identified as a Federal program at risk for improper payments.
The Stop Child Care Scam Act is a reasonable and commonsense solution to protect Federal taxpayer dollars from being defrauded.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to vote ``yes.''

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PARENTAL RIGHTS OVER THE EDUCATION AND CARE OF THEIR KIDS ACT
statements.title: PARENTAL RIGHTS OVER THE EDUCATION AND CARE OF THEIR KIDS ACT
sentences: Yet, across our country, school districts are actively pushing radical gender ideology on children and, in some cases, facilitating social transitions without parental knowledge or consent.
Unfortunately, with the rise of radical gender ideology today, many have lost what was called common sense.

The Heritage Foundation has written: ``A century of Supreme Court jurisprudence supports the notion that parents enjoy the fundamental constitutional right to direct the upbringing, health, and education of their children.'' We are not talking about nicknames on football teams.
If a child is struggling with gender dysphoria, then parents should be the first, not the last, to know.

Right now, according to Defending Education, at least 21,000 schools in 1,200 districts, covering over 12 million students, have policies that prevent faculty and staff from disclosing a student's gender identity to his own parents without the student's permission.

The Stopping Indoctrination and Protecting Kids Act is straightforward: Any district that promotes these ideologies in a classroom or conceals a child's gender transition from parents will lose Federal funding.
Mr. Speaker, I urge every one of my colleagues to vote ``yes'' on this important legislation.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SWEET AND SIMPLE TRUTHS ARE THE HEART OF THE UNITED STATES OF AMERICA
statements.title: SWEET AND SIMPLE TRUTHS ARE THE HEART OF THE UNITED STATES OF AMERICA
sentences: They ignore the rich history of our country, discounting our Nation's Founders and great documents of the past as outdated or primitive.

I am proud beyond words to call the United States of America my home, and I ask you today, whatever it is you might be looking for, instead of going to podcasts, conspiracy theories, or the fake news, look first to the sweet and simple truths held in the heart of my home and yours, the United States of America.

Mr. Speaker, I will read Katie's essay into the Record: As a child, I was fascinated with the Warner Bros. film, ``The Wizard of Oz,'' where the main character, Dorothy, was able to travel to a magical land over the rainbow in an attempt to find the truth that she was looking for.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: HIGHLIGHTING REPUBLICAN SUCCESSES IN 2025
statements.title: HIGHLIGHTING REPUBLICAN SUCCESSES IN 2025
sentences: We have seen real results on our southern border as illegal crossings and the flow of illicit drugs has dropped significantly.
In our schools and military, the emphasis is, once again, on merit instead of discriminatory DEI standards.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: IN REMEMBRANCE OF THE HONORABLE DOUG LaMALFA
statements.title: IN REMEMBRANCE OF THE HONORABLE DOUG LaMALFA
sentences: Rest assured, we will continue to carry on the torch that Doug championed so well.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: LOWER HEALTH CARE PREMIUMS FOR ALL AMERICANS ACT
statements.title: LOWER HEALTH CARE PREMIUMS FOR ALL AMERICANS ACT
sentences: Right now, small businesses are on an unequal playing field with larger companies and unions.
The problem is that healthcare in this country has become simply unaffordable for far too many businesses and working families.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to vote ``yes'' on H.R. 6703.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROMOTING EFFICIENT REVIEW FOR MODERN INFRASTRUCTURE TODAY ACT
statements.title: PROMOTING EFFICIENT REVIEW FOR MODERN INFRASTRUCTURE TODAY ACT
sentences: This legislation will finally bring clarity and consistency to the Clean Water Act permitting process by requiring the EPA to publish clear, accessible guidance on water quality certifications.
I am proud to support it, and I look forward to getting this across the finish line for Utahns and for Americans across the country.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROMOTING RESPONSIBLE OVERSIGHT TO ELIMINATE COMMUNIST TEACHINGS FOR OUR KIDS ACT
statements.title: PROMOTING RESPONSIBLE OVERSIGHT TO ELIMINATE COMMUNIST TEACHINGS FOR OUR KIDS ACT
sentences: For far too long, American education has been undermined from within by actors who have taken advantage of our free and open society to advance the nefarious and anti-freedom objectives of the Chinese Communist Party.
The CCP has even reached into elementary classrooms, cultivating favorable attitudes toward the Chinese Communist Party among young American students.
Mr. Speaker, I rise today in support of H.R. 1069, the PROTECT Our Kids Act.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF S.J. RES. 80, PROVIDING FOR CONGRESSIONAL DISAPPROVAL OF THE RULE SUBMITTED BY THE BUREAU OF LAND MANAGEMENT RELATING TO "NATIONAL PE
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF S.J. RES. 80, PROVIDING FOR CONGRESSIONAL DISAPPROVAL OF THE RULE SUBMITTED BY THE BUREAU OF LAND MANAGEMENT RELATING TO "NATIONAL PETROLEUM RESERVE IN ALASKA...
sentences: I urge my colleagues to support the rule and the eight underlying pieces of legislation.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROMISES MADE, PROMISES KEPT
statements.title: PROMISES MADE, PROMISES KEPT
sentences: The bill raises the death tax exemption, protects family farms, and strengthens food security for generations to come.
For working families, the results are just as clear.
For the first time, we are on the path to permanent school choice.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DELIVERING ON EDUCATIONAL FREEDOM
statements.title: DELIVERING ON EDUCATIONAL FREEDOM
sentences: It delivers tax-free Trump accounts for newborns, tax cuts for working families, and no tax on tips and overtime.
For millions of parents, the most powerful piece of this is that it delivers nationwide school choice.
This bill brings real education freedom to every ZIP Code in America.
Mr. Speaker, school choice funds students, not systems.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: EVENTS THIS WEEK
statements.title: EVENTS THIS WEEK
sentences: Mr. Speaker, this week, we honor the brave men and women who wear the badge, those who serve with courage, professionalism, and heart to keep our communities safe.
National Police Week is a time to give thanks and to reaffirm our support for the law enforcement officers, from Utah to D.C., who put their lives on the line every single day.
Today, I also want to honor a fallen hero from my home State of Utah, Sergeant Bill Hooser of the Santaquin Police Department.
Sergeant Hooser gave his life in the line of duty, and this week his name is being added to the National Law Enforcement Officers Memorial here in our Nation's Capital.
This week we are advancing commonsense legislation that equips, respects, and protects our law enforcement community.
God bless our law enforcement community.
We will never forget Bill's service or sacrifice.
We trust our officers, and we will fight to protect those who protect us.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DEFENDING EDUCATION TRANSPARENCY AND ENDING ROGUE REGIMES ENGAGING IN NEFARIOUS TRANSACTIONS ACT
statements.title: DEFENDING EDUCATION TRANSPARENCY AND ENDING ROGUE REGIMES ENGAGING IN NEFARIOUS TRANSACTIONS ACT
sentences: Mr. Chair, imagine our esteemed universities, pillars of free thought and innovation, quietly channeling millions into investments linked to the Chinese Communist Party, Russian oligarchs, or the Iranian regime.
Since 2013, U.S. colleges and universities have received over $1 billion from Chinese Communist Party-affiliated sources.

At the same time, these institutions, many of which proudly divest from fossil fuels and boycott Israel, are more than willing to accept foreign funding from adversaries who seek to undermine our Nation.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND GIRLS IN SPORTS ACT OF 2025
statements.title: PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND GIRLS IN SPORTS ACT OF 2025
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise in support of the Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act.
To my colleagues on both sides of the aisle, please join us as we support the Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act.
It is about what kind of country we are going to be.
